title: Finding
description: The atomic unit of Act I. A specialist seat emits one of these per issue. The verification panel later attaches verdicts; the synthesizer composes ONLY from verified findings. No 'confidence' field exists, by design (grounding rule 3).

seat_id.description: The seat that raised it, e.g. S-identification-A

tradition.description: The school/tradition/objective-function this seat speaks for

quote.description: Exact verbatim quote from the manuscript. MUST pass the deterministic quote-gate. May be empty ONLY if finding_type is 'absence-silence'. A 'contribution-undersell' finding MUST quote the under-leveraged result it builds from (its foothold), so it rides the quote-gate normally; its absence half rides absence_probe.

absence_probe.description: REQUIRED on absence-class findings ('absence-silence' and 'contribution-undersell'): the words and close paraphrases whose presence in the manuscript would REFUTE the claimed absence, searched deterministically by helpers/absence_gate.py. Supply at least 3 terms including paraphrases; fewer fails closed (the finding degrades to needs-author-confirmation, never to a silent pass).

issue.description: The problem, stated precisely and specifically to THIS paper.

proposed_fix.description: Concrete, actionable. Empty string if the fix is genuinely an author decision.

risk_of_fix.description: What could go wrong if the fix is applied naively; '' if none foreseen.

verification_status.description: Annotates the finding; NEVER vetoes its severity.

raised_by_n_blind_seats.description: Corroboration count, set during integration. Diagnostic only, never an auto-down-weighter.

absence_gate.description: ENGINE-ATTACHED annotation (never produced by a seat): the deterministic absence-gate certificate for absence-class findings, from helpers/absence_gate.py. The hit snippets are the steelman verifier's evidence trail.

panel_verdicts.description: ENGINE-ATTACHED annotation (never produced by a seat): the verification panel's per-angle verdicts, carried on every delivered finding for the session's verification/ record.
